source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: For Singles, start with random opponents in round one. In later rounds, the recommended order follows. **First**, group by record across wins, losses and draws. Two players at 3–1 can meet under this criterion. **Second**, factor in the sequence of wins and losses. **Third**, use random pairings within the same bracket.

recommendedOrder: record of wins, losses and draws
random among players in the same bracket
